description: What an amount in today's dollars will buy after a number of years at a given annual inflation rate, what today's basket will cost then, the cumulative price increase percent, and the purchasing power lost. Use when the user asks what money will be worth in the future, or what a future amount costs in today's dollars. For whether a raise keeps up use calculate_raise_vs_inflation. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive inflation calculator calculator.

include_schedule.description: Set to true to include the purchasing power schedule in 5 year steps (or about 6 steps for longer horizons), matching the page table.

name: calculate_inflation

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

inputs.description: The normalized inputs the calculation used.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.

tool.description: Name of the tool that ran.
